intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: DC power leads and terminated power cable assemblies.
intro.zh: 直流电源连接线及已端接电源电缆组件。

intro.en: Power connectors, contacts and wire for assembly selection.
intro.zh: 电源连接器、触点及组件选型用线材。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Check plug dimensions, keying, polarity and the mating inlet before selecting a reference.
copy.zh: 选型前核对插头尺寸、防错结构、极性及对接插座。

copy.en: Specify continuous current, peak load and cable length before setting conductor size.
copy.zh: 先确定持续电流、峰值负载与线长，再选择导体截面积。

copy.en: Review working voltage, insulation construction and the equipment installation conditions.
copy.zh: 结合工作电压、绝缘结构与设备安装条件进行核对。

copy.en: Set cable exits, clamp points and pull-force requirements for the finished assembly.
copy.zh: 确定成品的出线方向、固定位置与拉力要求。

copy.en: Select jacket and sealing against the actual heat, oil, moisture and movement exposure.
copy.zh: 按实际温度、油污、潮湿及运动工况选择护套与密封。

copy.en: Agree polarity, continuity and applicable insulation tests. Confirm project-specific safety requirements.
copy.zh: 约定极性、导通及适用的绝缘测试，并确认项目安全要求。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
